name: Time Machine
description: Mockable PSR-20 clock services for testing and QA of time-dependent code; provides drush time-machine:travel-to / :return.
project_description: Time Machine is a hidden helper submodule of Date Point. It replaces the date_point.clock (and core datetime.time) services with a mockable ProxyClock so time-dependent code can be frozen or shifted in automated tests and manual QA. It ships several PSR-20 clock implementations (frozen, memory, state, file, settings, random) and drush commands to travel to and return from a mocked time.
